name: smwmusic-touhou-gensoukyou-lotus-land-story-holding-onto-your-strength-sleeping-terror-remix
title: Touhou Gensoukyou ~ Lotus Land Story - Holding Onto Your Strength ~ Sleeping Terror (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Sleeping Terror from Touhou 4: Lotus Land Story. Was in the mood for another Touhou theme so I thought I'd do another PC-98 because I like Yuuka Kazami's theme a lot (way more than her PFoV theme... which is nothing new for me since it's the same with Alice's themes as well).

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.
